title: jmap-mail-client and jmap-chat-client: extension trait design
description: Design and document the extension trait pattern that jmap-mail-client and jmap-chat-client must use to add typed methods to JmapClient. The PLAN.md files for both crates show 'impl JmapClient { ... }' blocks which are invalid Rust for cross-crate inherent impls. This bead establishes the correct pattern before implementation begins in those crates.
design: Correct pattern is an extension trait, e.g.: pub trait JmapMailExt { async fn email_get(...) -> Result<...>; } impl JmapMailExt for JmapClient { ... }. This allows jmap-mail-client to define new methods on JmapClient without violating the orphan rule. Same pattern for jmap-chat-client: pub trait JmapChatExt. Both traits live in their respective crates and re-export from lib.rs. PLAN.md files for jmap-mail-client and jmap-chat-client must be updated to use this pattern. The extension trait must be in scope for callers (use jmap_mail_client::JmapMailExt). Evaluate whether to use async-trait crate or native async fn in trait (Rust 1.75 RPITIT).
